competences.description: Attacks the enemy and removes one beneficial effect with a 50% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

competences.description: Summons the soul of the dead ally, and then uses the target's skill once. At this time, the target's passive skill won't be applied. When used on a living ally excluding yourself, grants Soul Protection on the target for 2 turns and decreases the target's skill cooldown time by 1 turn.

effets.description: The target will revive with 30% HP when defeated.

competences.description: Applies all harmful effects granted on this battle to each enemy for 1 turn each and applies all beneficial effects to each ally for 2 turns each.

effets.description: Removes a buff from target monster and applies it to the casting monster.
Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.
